snippet.title: Bowling Alley Simulator - Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Here is a sneak peak of our new game Bowling Alley Simulator!

Bowling Alley Simulator lets you build, manage, and grow your own bowling alley. Run the lanes, cook classic food, hire staff, and expand your business into a thriving entertainment destination.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4465600/Bowling_Alley_Simulator/

Press Kit:
https://vulcron.com/bowling-alley-simulator.html
